--- CREATE CREDENTIAL
CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL ketakicreds
WITH 
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'

--- CREATE EXT DATA SOURCE 
CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_source 
WITH 
(
  LOCATION = 'https://ketakidatalake.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
  CREDENTIAL = ketakicreds    
)
